title: His old fellow made his tin by selling jalap to Zulus
html_source: Jalap is a cathartic drug consisting of the tuberous roots of Ipomaea Purga, a plant growing on the eastern declivities of the Mexican Andes. It derives its name from the city of Jalapa in Mexico, near which it grows. The “old fellow” made his money by selling jalap to Zulus.
